text:
Maya (CEO): Quick exec weekly 1: three headline asks this week: 1) finalize Private GA rollback criteria, 2) hit cost reduction milestone for hosted inference, 3) confirm SOC docs timeline. Short notes: 1) rollback criteria must be in the runbook by Thu noon.

Ori (VP Eng): Got it. Rollback criteria will include thresholds for p99, error-rate, and failed canary checks. Ill post the draft runbook after the morning sync.

Keisha (Head of Product): Product note: release notes must call out known limitations (no third-party integrations at GA). Also we need a short admin opt-out flow for telemetry. UX draft by Wed.

Tom (Finance): Cost ask: target is 10% unit-cost reduction vs last quarter. Please add expected savings per lever (batching, quantization, routing) by Tue COB.

Ruth (Security): SOC timeline: audit docs ready for internal review. If legal has any open items, flag by EOD Fri. Also add an event for "opt-out-ack" to the audit log.

Maya (CEO): Thanks. Owners: Ori  rollback/runbook, Keisha  release notes + opt-out UX, Tom  cost consolidation, Ruth  SOC/audit hooks. Friday 11:00 PT decision meeting.

Ori (VP Eng): DeployBot, schedule canary tomorrow 08:30 PT and tag metrics: p95, p99, cold-start, canary-e2e-optout.

DeployBot: Canary scheduled by Ori  build 2026.05.03-rlw-311. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Keisha (Head of Product): Posting the release notes draft link in #product-docs now.

Tom (Finance): Sharing a simple spreadsheet with lever owners and estimated deltas. Will update with conservative numbers.

Ruth (Security): Sending audit-event spec and SOC review checklist to this thread shortly.

Maya (CEO): Great. Keep updates short in-thread; escalate blockers to me directly. Focus is on clear go/no-go on Friday. :muscle:
